operations.targetPreviewed: Release identified and automatic library destination previewed
operations.replacementStarted: Searching across sites for an alternative of the same quality. The old task stays until the new source makes real progress.
operations.torrentAndFilesDeleted: Torrent task and data files deleted
operations.torrentDeleted: Torrent task deleted; data files kept
operations.identityNeedsConfirmation: Could not determine the title automatically. Confirm a candidate before choosing the automatic library destination.
operations.identityNotFound: Could not reliably identify this release. Search with another title or choose the save folder manually.
operations.alreadyAdded: This torrent is already in the downloader; it was not added again

removal.optionLabel: Also delete download tasks and source files
removal.optionHelp: Delete the matching downloader tasks and their data to free disk space. Source files cannot be recovered.
removal.noTask: No matching download task was found (the file was scanned or its source is unknown). Only library files will be deleted.

preview.defaultMissing: No default downloader is available. Add one in Settings → Downloaders and ensure its connection test passes.
preview.downloaderUnavailable: Downloader “{name}” is unavailable (disabled or not verified).
preview.noRoot: No library or library root is available. Downloads will use the downloader’s default directory and will not be imported automatically.
preview.noStagingLibrary: No library is available. Downloads will be organized into the custom directory, but returning files cannot be registered and subscriptions cannot complete. Create a library first.
preview.noWatchLibrary: No library is available. Torrents will download into the watched directory, but completed files cannot be imported automatically. Create a library first.
preview.unmapped: Directory {path} is not covered by downloader “{name}”’s path mappings, so submission will be rejected. Add a mapping for this directory or a shared parent directory, or configure a watched import rule for this library.

rescue.trial: Verifying a same-quality replacement; the old source is switched only after the new one makes at least 1 MiB of real progress
rescue.submitted: A same-quality replacement was submitted; waiting for real download progress
rescue.searching: Keeping the old source while searching other sites for a same-quality replacement
rescue.backoff: No same-quality replacement yet; the old source is kept and other sites will be searched again on schedule
rescue.retained: Replacement finished; the old task was kept because it wasn’t safe to remove
rescue.cleanupPending: The replacement took over; safely cleaning up the old task
rescue.noProgress: No download progress for 15 minutes. You can replace it now; it’s handled automatically at 30 minutes
rescue.downloaderUnverified: The downloader hasn’t passed the connection check
rescue.listFailed: Couldn’t read tasks. Check the downloader connection.
